name: Laravel 12 Artisan Command Optimization
description: Automated Artisan command execution and Laravel 12 optimization

steps.content:
⚙️ Laravel 12 Artisan Optimization:

✅ Commands auto-register from app/Console/Commands/
✅ No manual registration needed in Laravel 12
✅ Use descriptive command signatures
✅ Implement proper error handling
✅ Add progress indicators for long operations
✅ Use confirmation prompts for destructive operations
✅ Return appropriate exit codes
